section_summary: This section contains Department of State, War Department, and Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers (SCAP) correspondence from late 1947 concerning travel, trade, and entry clearance regulations for occupied Japan. It covers individual clearance applications for commercial entrants, diplomatic personnel, and spouses from countries including Syria, the Philippines, Panama, Lebanon, Mexico, South Africa, and Argentina, primarily administered under SCAP Circular No. 8 and related directives. Additional records address inquiries and concerns from American businesses regarding Japanese import/export needs, scrap rubber requirements, and economic competition from Japanese chick sexers.

subfiles.about: Documents telephone coordination regarding the adjustment of entry clearance dates for Syrian commercial entrant Faez Ejel.
subfiles.summary: O'Brien confirms with the Military Permit Office and Syrian officials that Faez Ejel is cleared to enter Japan.
subfiles.title: Memorandum of Conversation: Change of Clearance Date for Mr. Ejel to Enter Japan

subfiles.about: Records discussion regarding misplaced entry application forms for Philippine official Yusup Abubakar and requests duplicates.
subfiles.summary: O'Brien and Ruiz discuss misplaced Form DS-513 for Yusup Abubakar; Ruiz agrees to submit duplicate forms.
subfiles.title: Memorandum of Conversation: Application of Mr. Yusup Abubakar to Enter Japan

subfiles.about: Applies for permission for a Philippine foreign affairs officer to visit Yokohama during a brief steamer stopover.
subfiles.summary: Duplicate Form DS-513 application by Yusup Abubakar to visit Yokohama during stopover of SS General Gordon.
subfiles.title: Application for Permission to Enter Japan (Form DS-513): Yusup Abubakar
subfiles.to: Secretary of the Joint Chiefs of Staff

subfiles.about: Requests entry authorization into Japan for alien Northwest Airlines stewardesses, including a Portuguese citizen.
subfiles.summary: Manila Embassy transmits inquiry concerning Japan entry authorization for Northwest Airlines alien stewardesses, including Guermra E. de Senna.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 293 from Manila regarding Entry Authorization for NWA Stewardesses

subfiles.about: Instructs Manila Embassy on diplomatic and SCAP Circular 8 channels required for Philippine and Portuguese airline personnel.
subfiles.summary: State Department instructs Manila Embassy on diplomatic channels under SCAP Circular 8 for Philippine and Portuguese airline personnel.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 1291 to Manila regarding Entry Authorization for NWA Stewardesses

subfiles.about: Confirms revised clearance window for Syrian traveler Faez Ejel with the Syrian Legation.
subfiles.summary: O'Brien confirms to Syrian Legation attache Pasha that Faez Ejel is cleared for entry through January 10, 1948.
subfiles.title: Memorandum of Conversation: Confirmation of Clearance for Mr. Faez Ejel

subfiles.about: Formally informs the Syrian Minister of SCAP clearance for Faez Abdallah Ejel to travel to Japan for business.
subfiles.summary: Informs the Syrian Minister that Faez Abdallah Ejel is cleared to enter Japan for 21 days between December 25, 1947 and January 10, 1948, requiring an English statement under SCAP Circular 8.
subfiles.title: Note from Acting Secretary of State to the Minister of Syria regarding Clearance for Faez Abdallah Ejel

subfiles.about: Transmits SCAP directive on marriage registration and summarizes policy regarding non-Japanese spouses entering Japan.
subfiles.from: United States Political Adviser for Japan, Tokyo
subfiles.summary: Transmits SCAPIN 1822 instructing Japanese authorities to register non-Japanese wives entering with Japanese husbands, while excluding foreign husbands.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 1429: Entry Into Japan of Non-Japanese Married to Japanese Nationals

subfiles.about: Instructs the Japanese Government on marriage registration and entry prohibitions for foreign and Korean spouses of Japanese nationals.
subfiles.from: General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: SCAP directive authorizing registration of non-Japanese wives accompanying Japanese husbands, but prohibiting entry and marriage registration for foreign and Korean husbands without written authorization.
subfiles.title: SCAPIN 1822: Entry into Japan of Korean and Other Foreign Nationals Related to Japanese Nationals in Unregistered Marriage

subfiles.about: Reports an informal commercial cable from Argentina and recommends advising the Argentine Embassy on SCAP Circular 8 procedures.
subfiles.from: J. D. Scott, Military Permit Section, War Department
subfiles.summary: Military Permit Section forwards Argentine cable requesting entry for a commercial traveler and recommends instructing the Argentine Embassy on SCAP Circular 8 procedures.
subfiles.title: War Department Memorandum regarding Argentine Query on Entrance into Japan
subfiles.to: Walter F. Chappell, Department of State

subfiles.about: Transmits application Form DS-513 to diplomatic missions of governments lacking representation in Japan.
subfiles.summary: Distributes application Form DS-513 to diplomatic missions lacking representation in Japan to facilitate transmission of travel requests under SCAP Circular 8.
subfiles.title: Circular Note to Chiefs of Mission regarding Application Form DS-513 for Entry into Japan

subfiles.about: Notifies foreign missions of modified procedures for civilian entry into Japan and transmits SCAP Circular No. 8.
subfiles.summary: Transmits SCAP Circular No. 8 to foreign missions and offers State Department transmission of entry requests for countries not represented in Japan.
subfiles.title: Circular Note to Chiefs of Mission regarding Travel Regulations into and from Japan

subfiles.about: Sets forth comprehensive occupation regulations governing entry and exit of individuals, aircraft, and maritime vessels into and from Japan.
subfiles.from: General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: Promulgates detailed occupation procedures governing the entry and exit of military and civilian individuals, aircraft, and surface merchant and combatant vessels in Japan. Individuals require prior SCAP clearance, valid travel documents, and specific medical vaccinations, with entry permits issued at ports of entry. Aircraft and naval vessels must receive advance clearance, follow designated routing, observe radio communication protocols, and submit cargo manifests.
subfiles.title: GHQ SCAP Circular No. 8: Control of Entry and Exit of Individuals, Aircraft and Surface Vessels Into and From Japan

subfiles.about: Advises the Argentine Ambassador of required procedures under SCAP Circular 8 following an informal cable sent to CINCFE.
subfiles.summary: Informs Argentine Ambassador that an entry request cabled by Bramuglia cannot be processed directly, advising submission through the State Department using Form DS-513 under SCAP Circular 8.
subfiles.title: Note from Acting Secretary of State to the Ambassador of Argentina regarding Entry Procedures for Japan

subfiles.about: Confirms telephone adjustment of entry clearance dates for Syrian merchant Faez Ejel.
subfiles.from: J. D. Scott, Military Permit Section, War Department
subfiles.summary: Confirms telephone agreement altering Faez Ejel's entry clearance window to December 25 through January 10.
subfiles.title: War Department Memorandum regarding Alteration of Faez Ejel's Clearance Dates
subfiles.to: Walter F. Chappell, Department of State

subfiles.about: Documents notice of SCAP trader clearance for Panamanian national Meyer Abadi and telephone coordination with Panamanian officials.
subfiles.summary: O'Brien informs Bennett that Meyer Abadi is cleared by SCAP under the trader quota for 21 days in January 1948.
subfiles.title: Memorandum of Conversation: Travel to Japan of Mr. Meyer Abadi

subfiles.about: Transmits supplementary commercial details from the Panamanian Embassy regarding Meyer Abadi to the War Department.
subfiles.from: Walter F. Chappell, Department of State
subfiles.summary: Transmits Panamanian Embassy note detailing Meyer Abadi's commercial purpose and requests resubmission of his application to SCAP.
subfiles.title: Letter from Walter F. Chappell to Colonel O. N. Lynch regarding Application of Meyer Abadi
subfiles.to: Colonel O. N. Lynch, Military Permit Section, Department of the Army

subfiles.about: Provides commercial data concerning Meyer Abadi of Abadi Hnos. for his proposed purchasing trip to Japan.
subfiles.from: J. J. Vallarino, Ambassador of Panama
subfiles.summary: Submits supplementary information regarding Meyer Abadi of Abadi Hnos., specifying his plan to purchase cotton and rayon textiles in Japan.
subfiles.title: Note No. D-956 from Embassy of Panama regarding Commercial Data for Meyer Abadi
subfiles.to: George C. Marshall, Secretary of State

subfiles.about: Notifies the Panamanian Embassy that Meyer Abadi has been cleared by SCAP for a 21-day commercial stay in Japan.
subfiles.summary: Informs Panamanian Embassy that Meyer Abadi is cleared to enter Japan for 21 days between January 1 and 15, 1948.
subfiles.title: Note from Secretary of State to the Charge d'Affaires of Panama regarding Clearance for Meyer Abadi
subfiles.to: Chargé d'Affaires ad interim of Panama

subfiles.about: Transmits duplicate entry application Form DS-513 for Lebanese commercial representative Husni Halabi.
subfiles.summary: Transmits duplicate Form DS-513 application for Lebanese trade representative Husni Halabi to travel to Japan.
subfiles.title: Note from Legation of Lebanon regarding Japan Entry Application for Husni Halabi

subfiles.about: Submits application for a Lebanese merchant to study textile, glassware, and shoe trade opportunities in Kobe.
subfiles.summary: Application Form DS-513 by Lebanese merchant Husni Halabi to visit Kobe to investigate textile, glassware, and shoe trade.
subfiles.title: Application for Permission to Enter Japan (Form DS-513): Husni Halabi

subfiles.about: Reports no objection to the local re-entry application of Swift International representative William Kenneth Clark.
subfiles.from: J. D. Scott, Military Permit Section, War Department
subfiles.summary: Notifies State Department of no objection to local application of William Kenneth Clark to re-enter Japan for Swift International.
subfiles.title: War Department Memorandum regarding Re-entry of William Kenneth Clark into Japan

subfiles.about: Transmits CINCFE cable and closes the case of Roberto Gomez Cisneros due to duplicate Mexican trade representation.
subfiles.from: J. D. Scott, Military Permit Section, War Department
subfiles.summary: Transmits CINCFE cable regarding Mexican trade representatives and closes Roberto Gomez Cisneros's case due to apparent duplication.
subfiles.title: War Department Memorandum regarding Roberto Gomez Cisneros
subfiles.to: Walter F. Chappell, Department of State

subfiles.about: Questions the proposed entry of Roberto Gomez Cisneros in view of prior clearances for Enrique Bravo and Jose Calero.
subfiles.summary: CINCFE questions proposed entry of Roberto Gomez Cisneros, citing existing clearances for Mexican representatives Enrique Bravo and Jose Calero.
subfiles.title: Incoming Clear Message No. W 90959 from CINCFE Tokyo regarding Mexican Trade Representatives

subfiles.about: Requests clarification from Mexico regarding its trade representatives in Japan in light of existing clearances.
subfiles.summary: Requests clarification from the Mexican Ambassador regarding the official status of Roberto Gomez Cisneros in light of prior clearances granted to Enrique Bravo and Jose Calero.
subfiles.title: Note from Acting Secretary of State to the Ambassador of Mexico regarding Trade Representatives in Japan

subfiles.about: Reports that Revendas Chunilal Patel's application is not authorized under current commercial entrant categories.
subfiles.from: J. D. Scott, Military Permit Section, War Department
subfiles.summary: Reports that Revendas Chunilal Patel is not authorized entry under current commercial categories and suggests re-applying when categories expand.
subfiles.title: War Department Memorandum regarding Application of Revendas Chunilal Patel
subfiles.to: Walter F. Chappell, Department of State

subfiles.about: Informs the South African Legation that Revendas Chunilal Patel's entry request cannot be approved under current categories.
subfiles.summary: Informs South African Minister that Revendas Chunilal Patel's entry application cannot be approved under current commercial categories unless restated in detail.
subfiles.title: Note from Acting Secretary of State to the Minister of the Union of South Africa regarding Revendas Chunilal Patel
subfiles.to: Minister of the Union of South Africa

subfiles.about: Protests the potential issuance of exit permits to Japanese chick sexers to work in Belgium and Europe.
subfiles.from: J. N. Namba, American Chick Sexing Association
subfiles.summary: Protests reports that Japanese chick sexers may receive exit permits to work in Belgium, requesting protection for American enterprise and GI trainees abroad.
subfiles.title: Letter from American Chick Sexing Association regarding Exit Permits for Japanese Chick Sexers

subfiles.about: Explains that the exit of Japanese nationals is under SCAP control and no permits have been granted to chick sexers.
subfiles.from: Winthrop G. Brown, Department of State
subfiles.summary: Informs Namba that exit of Japanese nationals is controlled by SCAP, no permits have been granted, and applications are made to SCAP.
subfiles.title: Letter from Department of State to J. N. Namba regarding Exit of Japanese Nationals
subfiles.to: J. N. Namba, American Chick Sexing Association

subfiles.about: Provides passport information and travel itinerary for Vice President Isaak Yanowitch's proposed journey to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Provides passport details and travel itinerary for Vice President Isaak Yanowitch, requesting his Japan entry permit be mailed to New York.
subfiles.title: Letter from Yanowe Brothers Corporation regarding Entry Information for Isaak Yanowitch
subfiles.to: Walter F. Chappell, Department of State

subfiles.about: Acknowledges and processes entry permit arrangements for Isaak Yanowitch of Yanowe Brothers Corporation.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges Yanowe Brothers Corporation's letter regarding Isaak Yanowitch's travel arrangements and documentation for entry into Japan.
subfiles.title: Letter from Department of State to Yanowe Brothers Corporation regarding Isaak Yanowitch

subfiles.about: Transmits case documents regarding P. Baudry and A. Schulman Inc. to the Division of Occupied Areas Economic Affairs.
subfiles.from: D. O'Brien, Division of Protective Services
subfiles.summary: Transmits case papers concerning P. Baudry of A. Schulman Inc. to McCormick in Economic Affairs.
subfiles.title: Office Memorandum regarding A. Schulman Inc. Case Files
subfiles.to: Mr. McCormick, Division of Occupied Areas Economic Affairs

subfiles.about: Explains postponement of Frank Francis's Japan trip and inquires about Japanese industrial requirements for scrap rubber.
subfiles.summary: Explains postponement of Frank Francis's trip to Japan and inquires regarding Japanese industry requirements for scrap rubber.
subfiles.title: Letter from A. Schulman Inc. regarding Postponement of Visit and Scrap Rubber Inquiry
subfiles.to: Walter F. Chappell, Department of State

subfiles.about: Explains to the Commerce Department that Frank Francis's diversion to Manila requires postponing his planned December trip to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Informs Gilbert Ford that representative Frank Francis was sent to Manila, necessitating postponement of his scheduled December trip to Japan.
subfiles.title: Letter Copy from A. Schulman Inc. to Gilbert Ford regarding Postponement of Travel to Japan

subfiles.about: Provides information regarding Japanese scrap rubber import needs and suggests contacting Boeki Cho in New York.
subfiles.from: Winthrop G. Brown, Department of State
subfiles.summary: Provides data on Japanese scrap rubber imports and suggests contacting the Boeki Cho agency in New York.
subfiles.title: Letter from Department of State to P. Baudry regarding Japanese Scrap Rubber Requirements
